env_files.role: Enterprise-wide Catalog 4.8 baseline with entity, field, key, lifecycle, and release metadata
Baseline architecture review narrative and final 4.8 reconciliation notes
Baseline scope, precedence, as-of, and diagram-convention notice
Proposed correction operations across current, prior, future, adjacent, and rejected designs
Multi-event request histories used to resolve approval, readiness, withdrawal, rejection, and supersession at the cutoff
Bundle lifecycle events used to select the effective Catalog 4.8 production correction bundle
Cutoff, precedence, dependency, sequencing, rename-cascade, and handoff rules
Deployment-wave lifecycle records used to select the current production activation wave
Request-to-deployment-unit mapping with atomic groups, order, dependencies, scope, and environment
Unit-level canary, verification, rollback, suspension, and failure events at the deployment cutoff
Wave selection, unit activation, atomic-group, rollback, and final diagram handoff rules

source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed environment. Solve only from task.md and env files.

design_notes: Difficulty comes from a two-stage state transition: request eligibility followed by production deployment activation.
An implementation-ready correction is not automatically current; wave selection, unit state, atomic groups, dependencies, rollback, and suspension must also be resolved.
The dataset contains 64 correction requests and more than 290 request/deployment events across current, future, staging, adjacent-scope, rejected, withdrawn, canary-only, and rolled-back records.
The final model contains a mix of applied changes and baseline state retained after deployment reversion.
Each Grounded VQA checks a compact entity, field set, relationship pair, or two-outcome state decision rather than a large all-or-nothing fact bundle.
No agent-visible file directly states the final entity/relationship set.
